text: Moving to Dallas from out of state in a few months, can anyone recommend a good buyer's agent? Looking in the Frisco/Plano area. TIA!
comment_source_reason: The post asks for an agent recommendation in the Dallas area, so almost everyone answering with their own service is a real-estate agent -- every one of them is out-of-area for the Orange-County realtor target, while the same commenters are solo_agency's customers (independent professionals) wherever they are located. NOTE: because this thread's core dynamic is "out-of-area, mostly drop" for the target, its real-keep rate for the target client is intentionally very low (nearly every provider answering is an agent outside Orange County, an explicit not_buyer) -- this is the documented trap for this thread, not an error; two thread-drift replies about an actual move into Orange County were added so the target still has something genuine to find.
